response.sql: WITH status_rates AS (SELECT si.healtheval, AVG(sc.gbsize / NULLIF(sc.spanmin, 0)) AS rate, COUNT(*) AS scan_count FROM scans AS sc JOIN sites AS si ON sc.zoneref = si.zoneregistry GROUP BY si.healtheval), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS all_status_rate FROM status_rates) SELECT AVG(sr.rate) AS average_rate, AVG(sr.scan_count) AS average_scan_count, AVG(sr.rate - b.all_status_rate) AS average_excess_rate FROM status_rates AS sr CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE sr.rate > b.all_status_rate;

assumptions.assumption: The number of scans means the number of matched rows in scans. Zero-minute durations have no defined rate and are ignored by AVG.

alternatives.interpretation: If the number of scans means the total recorded in scans.scancount across scan sets, sum that field instead of counting rows.
alternatives.sql: WITH status_rates AS (SELECT si.healtheval, AVG(sc.gbsize / NULLIF(sc.spanmin, 0)) AS rate, SUM(sc.scancount) AS scan_count FROM scans AS sc JOIN sites AS si ON sc.zoneref = si.zoneregistry GROUP BY si.healtheval), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS all_status_rate FROM status_rates) SELECT AVG(sr.rate) AS average_rate, AVG(sr.scan_count) AS average_scan_count, AVG(sr.rate - b.all_status_rate) AS average_excess_rate FROM status_rates AS sr CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE sr.rate > b.all_status_rate;
